question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To take stock of
solution:
The correct answer is **'To assess'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To take stock of means is **to think carefully about a situation and form an opinion about it so that the decision can be made.**(किसी स्थिति के बारे में सावधानी से सोचना और उसके बारे में एक राय बनाना ताकि निर्णय लिया जा सके।)
 
• For example:
 
 
• It was time **to take stock **of the situation.
 
• I am in my thirties when most of the people **take stock **and determine the working sector.
 
• The **synonym **of the given idiom - review the situation, evaluate, and **assess**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Lets understand the meaning of the words given in the options.

 
• To discuss means **to talk about something with people.**
 
• To assemble means **gathering together in one place for a common purpose.**
 
• To modify means **to make partial or minor changes to something.**
